summary.headline: January–February Thunder Omens
summary.text: Astrological weather omens for January and February: thunder, heavenly sounds, nightfall, and earthquakes portend war, famine, disease, crop failure or abundance, instability, and destruction of livestock, reptiles, and wild beasts. Thunder in Pisces is associated with grain ruin and danger throughout the inhabited world.
